headline: McDonald's Tests New Value Menu Amid Industry Discount Wars
summary: McDonald's is overhauling its menu to test a new value option as fast-food discount competition intensifies.
why: McDonald's is a globally prominent fast-food restaurant chain whose pricing and menu strategies heavily influence consumer discretionary spending and sector-wide competitive dynamics.

impacts.name: McDonald's Corporation
impacts.why: McDonald's is the subject of the menu overhaul and value testing.
